name: Digivated Starter
custom_summary: Up to 3 launches at a time, each live the moment you publish. $3 once.
description:
Room for 3 launches.

Starter is $3, paid once. No subscription.

Every account gets one free launch. Starter lets you have 3 projects on the site at a time, and each one goes live the moment you publish it. No review queue, no badge needed. Archive or delete a project whenever you want to free a slot.

Need more than 3? Membership ($5) makes it unlimited.

How to use it

Buy with the email you use on Digivated. Then open https://digivated.com/new-launch and press “I’ve paid, check again”.

Projects still follow the listing rules, and traffic or sales aren't guaranteed.
custom_receipt: Thanks for getting Digivated Starter. You can now have up to 3 projects on the site at a time, each live the moment you publish. Use the same email as your Digivated account, then press “I’ve paid, check again” at https://digivated.com/new-launch. It's a one-time purchase.
